newsitem.title: USA: US aluminum oxide bids range $450-$485/short ton.
newsitem.headline: US aluminum oxide bids range $450-$485/short ton.

text.p: The U.S. Defense National Stockpile Center said Tuesday it received bids from four firms to buy surplus U.S. aluminum oxide abrasive grain at a price ranging from $450 to $485 per short ton.
High bidder was United Abrasive Inc which offered to buy a total of 22 short tons of aluminum oxide grain in six lots at a unit price of $485 per short ton.
Low bidder was AGSCO of New Jersey, which offered to purchase a total of 40 short tons in nine lots at a unit price of $450 per short ton.
